name: datadog
description: Datadog (logs, metrics, traces, monitors) integration via MCP

datadog_api_key.title: Datadog API key
datadog_api_key.description: Identifies your organization. Create one at Organization Settings → API Keys. Stored in the OS keychain, not in settings.json.

datadog_app_key.title: Datadog application key
datadog_app_key.description: Identifies you and authorizes read / query endpoints. Create one at Organization Settings → Application Keys. Stored in the OS keychain, not in settings.json.

datadog_site.title: Datadog site
datadog_site.description: Your Datadog region, taken from the URL after you log in. e.g. datadoghq.com (US1), us3.datadoghq.com, us5.datadoghq.com, datadoghq.eu, ap1.datadoghq.com, ddog-gov.com.
